prose: LLM 0.37.2 fixes two paths that could send a configured OpenAI key to another OpenAI-compatible provider. Simon Willison says the problem could occur when a named provider key was absent, or when a Responses-configured model was invoked with a chat-completions override. The release addresses credential selection across endpoints rather than a model-quality issue.
highlights: A missing named key could select the wrong credential
A request-mode override exposed a second path
Endpoint configuration is the relevant boundary
